clips.speaker: Mira Iyer
clips.title: Mira Iyer：标普盈利预期25%？市场短期无虞

subtitles.en: The expectations are 20-something percent. Historically, the S&P 500 beats those by about 4-5-6 percent depending on the quarter, which is a pretty punchy goal. Let's call it 25 percent is what largely we expect when to say we mean the market.
subtitles.zh: 市场预期盈利增长20%以上。历史来看，标普500每季度通常能超额完成4-6个百分点，这个目标相当激进。我们大致认为市场隐含的预期是25%。

subtitles.en: We think we'll hit that, which probably means good things for markets for the next couple of weeks at least. There's no reason to think that there will be any sort of slowdown given how much money is being spent in AI, given how well the consumer in the U.S. has held up, and frankly the stock market has held up as well.
subtitles.zh: 我们认为能达到，这对未来几周的市场至少是利好。AI领域投入巨大，美国消费韧性十足，权益市场也表现稳健，没有理由预期会放缓。

clips.speaker_context: Global Head of Investment Solutions at Leo Wealth

clips.speaker: Mira Iyer
clips.title: Mira Iyer：美国市场领涨格局生变？科技七巨头短期仍强
title_lines: 美国市场领涨格局生变？

subtitles.en: This is an interesting question. So again, I would put it into two phases. The next few months, I think it continues as is.
subtitles.zh: 这个问题很有意思。我分两个阶段看：未来几个月，我认为格局不变。

subtitles.en: The MAX7 are going to report great earnings. The hyperscalers are going to continue to re-emphasize their commitment to AI cat-packs, which should be good for the semiconductors, and the cell of the we've seen may even abate in the semiconductors for the next month or two.
subtitles.zh: 科技七巨头将交出亮眼财报，云巨头会重申AI资本开支承诺，利好半导体板块，未来一两个月半导体领域的抛压可能减弱。

subtitles.en: Because there will be a reconformation of the free cash flow coming their way. But a few months out, that's where I think challenges start to emerge.
subtitles.zh: 因为自由现金流将得到确认。但几个月后，挑战可能开始显现。

clips.speaker_context: Global Head of Investment Solutions at Leo Wealth

clips.speaker: Mira Iyer
clips.title: Mira Iyer：美国就业数据转弱，经济进入“加时赛”

subtitles.en: The employment number we got last week wasn't exactly rosy, 57,000 new jobs, a bit of a restatement down of some of the past numbers, but more importantly, participation rates down.
subtitles.zh: 上周的就业数据并不乐观，新增就业5.7万，前值也下修，更重要的是劳动参与率下降。

subtitles.en: Long-term unemployed up. The sense we have is that the U.S. economy is slowly entering, you know, either stoppage time to use a World Cup or extra time.
subtitles.zh: 长期失业人数上升。我们的感觉是，美国经济正缓慢进入——用世界杯术语来说——伤停补时或加时赛。

subtitles.en: Yes, exactly. And that means a slow down across the board. The gap between U.S. growth and non-U.S. growth ending potentially.
subtitles.zh: 没错，这意味着全面放缓。美国与非美国经济增长的差距可能正在收窄。

clips.speaker_context: Global Head of Investment Solutions at Leo Wealth

clips.speaker: Mira Iyer
clips.title: Mira Iyer：一次加息无伤大雅，但工资无压力为何要动？
title_lines: 但工资无压力为何要动？

subtitles.en: So one rate hike is not a problem at all. 25 basis points change in funding costs for economies is largely not meant. No one changes their behavior because there's 25 basis points more expensive.
subtitles.zh: 一次加息根本不是问题。25个基点的融资成本变动对经济影响不大，没有人会因为贵了25个基点就改变行为。

subtitles.en: Now, if it's 1% or 2% more expensive, that's a different story. But our sense is if they do anything, it'll be 25 basis points kind of an insurance hike just to show that they've done something you're on inflation.
subtitles.zh: 但如果贵了1%或2%，那就另当别论。我们的感觉是，即便加息，也只会是25个基点的“保险式”加息，表明他们对通胀有所行动。

subtitles.en: But I would question why it's needed. You have no wage pressure. No wage inflation pressure whatsoever. The easiest argument maybe is that AI threats are making very difficult for employees to ask for raises.
subtitles.zh: 但我质疑其必要性。根本没有工资压力，没有工资通胀压力。最简单的解释或许是，AI威胁让员工很难要求加薪。
